units.source_en: “Close your eyes and picture me.”

paragraphs.source_en: What was he up to? That incorrigible boy… Nōhime thought, but she obediently closed her eyes and tried to picture Nobunaga.

units.source_en: What was he up to?

ja.t: をするつもりなのだろう。

units.source_en: That incorrigible boy… Nōhime thought, but she obediently closed her eyes and tried to picture Nobunaga.
units.source_zh: 这个顽童⋯⋯浓姬想，但她顺从地闭上了眼睛，努力想象信长的模样。

paragraphs.source_zh: 他要干什么？这个顽童⋯⋯浓姬想，但她顺从地闭上了眼睛，努力想象信长的模样。

units.source_en: “Can you see me?”
“Yes.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Now dress me in a general’s robes.”

units.source_en: “Now dress me in a general’s robes.”
units.source_zh: “接下来，给我穿上将军的衣服。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “接下来，给我穿上将军的衣服。”

units.source_en: “What?”
“No questions. Put them on me.”
“Very well.”
“Well? Do they fit me?”

paragraphs.source_en: Resentment stirred in Nōhime’s heart; after all, this was only a game. Yet for all her resentment, the Nobunaga of her imagination looked every inch a stately general, as vivid as the living man himself.

units.source_en: Resentment stirred in Nōhime’s heart; after all, this was only a game.
units.source_zh: 浓姬心生恨意，这毕竟只是游戏。

units.source_en: Yet for all her resentment, the Nobunaga of her imagination looked every inch a stately general, as vivid as the living man himself.
units.source_zh: 虽然心中恨他，浓姬幻想中的那个信长却极像堂堂将军，直如真人。

paragraphs.source_zh: 浓姬心生恨意，这毕竟只是游戏。虽然心中恨他，浓姬幻想中的那个信长却极像堂堂将军，直如真人。

paragraphs.source_en: Nobunaga’s hand slipped quietly down from Nōhime’s shoulder, and then he clasped her in a passionate embrace. A sweet tenderness enveloped her body. How she wished this bliss would never fade.

units.source_en: Nobunaga’s hand slipped quietly down from Nōhime’s shoulder, and then he clasped her in a passionate embrace.
units.source_zh: 信长的手悄悄从浓姬的肩膀往下滑去，然后热烈地拥抱住她。

units.source_en: A sweet tenderness enveloped her body.
units.source_zh: 一种甜美的柔情包裹住浓姬的身体。

units.source_en: How she wished this bliss would never fade.
units.source_zh: 她真希望这种幸福的感觉永远不要消失。

paragraphs.source_zh: 信长的手悄悄从浓姬的肩膀往下滑去，然后热烈地拥抱住她。一种甜美的柔情包裹住浓姬的身体。她真希望这种幸福的感觉永远不要消失。

paragraphs.source_en: “Will you serve me for the rest of your life?”

units.source_en: “Will you serve me for the rest of your life?”
“I will.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Nō, I shall come to love you too. Let us make peace.”

units.source_en: “Nō, I shall come to love you too.
Let us make peace.”

paragraphs.source_zh: “阿浓，我也会喜欢上你的。我们和好吧。”

units.source_en: “Yes.”

paragraphs.source_en: “If I ever betray you, you may tear me limb from limb.”

units.source_en: “If I ever betray you, you may tear me limb from limb.”
units.source_zh: “如果我背叛你，你可以把我碎尸万段。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “如果我背叛你，你可以把我碎尸万段。”

paragraphs.source_en: Nōhime could no longer answer. Nobunaga’s burning kiss descended upon her lips like a tempest. The light had not yet entirely faded from the sky. The room lay utterly still, with only the sound of the wind scattering fallen leaves. Yet to Nōhime’s eyes, they were all spring flowers vying in splendor.

units.source_en: Nōhime could no longer answer.

ja.t: えることができなかった。

units.source_en: Nobunaga’s burning kiss descended upon her lips like a tempest.
units.source_zh: 信长炽热的吻如同暴风雨般盖住了她的嘴唇。

units.source_en: The light had not yet entirely faded from the sky.
The room lay utterly still, with only the sound of the wind scattering fallen leaves.
units.source_zh: 房间里一片寂静，只听到风吹落叶的声音。

units.source_en: Yet to Nōhime’s eyes, they were all spring flowers vying in splendor.
units.source_zh: 但浓姬眼里，那全是争奇斗艳的春花。

paragraphs.source_zh: 浓姬已经无法回答了。信长炽热的吻如同暴风雨般盖住了她的嘴唇。天还未黑尽。房间里一片寂静，只听到风吹落叶的声音。但浓姬眼里，那全是争奇斗艳的春花。

paragraphs.source_en: After a long while, Nobunaga suddenly pushed Nōhime away. Her long-forgotten modesty surged back, and Nōhime hurriedly straightened her disordered clothes. Flustered and disheveled, she found love and hatred entwined within her heart.

units.source_en: After a long while, Nobunaga suddenly pushed Nōhime away.
units.source_zh: 良久，信长突然推开了浓姬。

units.source_en: Her long-forgotten modesty surged back, and Nōhime hurriedly straightened her disordered clothes.
units.source_zh: 消失已久的羞耻心再次涌现，浓姬慌忙整理好凌乱的衣衫。

units.source_en: Flustered and disheveled, she found love and hatred entwined within her heart.
units.source_zh: 她狼狈不堪，心头爱恨交织。

paragraphs.source_zh: 良久，信长突然推开了浓姬。消失已久的羞耻心再次涌现，浓姬慌忙整理好凌乱的衣衫。她狼狈不堪，心头爱恨交织。
